meaning: The replication baseline for Liu 2019 TII is technically complete for seed 42. This does NOT mean exact reproduction of every unspecified Liu implementation detail. Known mismatches and reconstructions remain documented.

gates_passed.M_AUDIT_DECISION: B — KNOWN_MISMATCH retained (analytical M=3, DES M=1)

known_mismatches_and_limitations.label: M3_DES_OPERATIONAL_SEMANTICS_ARE_UNDERSPECIFIED_BY_LIU
known_mismatches_and_limitations.description: Liu Table I specifies M=3 blocks per DRL epoch for PBFT/Zyzzyva. DES realizes M=1. Sensitivity check (654 evaluations) found 0 C2 classification changes. Analytical M=3 retained.

known_mismatches_and_limitations.label: KNOWN_DES_RUNTIME_GUARD_LIMITATION
known_mismatches_and_limitations.description: 9/320 (2.8%) evaluation steps ended with RUNTIME_GUARD_FAILURE (PBFT view-change cap, OUR_RECONSTRUCTION). Random=16, Strong Fixed=11. Not DQN-specific. Not reinterpreted as C2 results.

known_mismatches_and_limitations.label: OUR_RECONSTRUCTION — exact state composition (Eq.10)
known_mismatches_and_limitations.description: Liu Eq.10 defines S_t=[chi, Upsilon, x, c, R(t)]. Normalization constants, tensor ordering, and link-rate encoding are OUR_RECONSTRUCTION.

known_mismatches_and_limitations.label: OUR_RECONSTRUCTION — FSMC transition model
known_mismatches_and_limitations.description: Liu specifies R(t) evolves dynamically but gives no FSMC transition kernel. Our FSMC is an OUR_RECONSTRUCTION based on plausible link-state Markov dynamics.

known_mismatches_and_limitations.label: Seed-42 only; seeds 123 and 7 not yet run
known_mismatches_and_limitations.description: Full robustness experiment (3 seeds) not yet complete. Seeds 123 and 7 are optional experiments for later.
